title: Retrieval and context packs
objective: Reference resolution, typed-relation traversal, source tracing, ranked retrieval, and budgeted context-pack assembly work over the SQLite projection and canonical files, serialized against a public context-pack schema.
business_value: Context packs are the product's core promise — a fresh agent session recovering precise, traceable operational context (UC-002, UC-004, the doc-00 success signal).
scope: Implement src/workctx/retrieval/: reference resolution (workctx:// to entity records via WP-210 query APIs; artifact:// and repo:// to source descriptors), inbound/outbound typed traversal with depth control, and source tracing from task/claim through observations to locators (doc-03 trace behavior)

Ranking per doc-03: relation semantics, recency of reliable evidence, current-vs-superseded state, confidence, directness, query match, and source quality — as a documented, deterministic scoring function with unit-tested ordering
Context-pack assembly per the doc-03 ten-point structure with a token/size budget, deterministic truncation order, and truncation metadata explaining what was cut
Current-vs-historical claim handling: packs present current claims and expose superseded history on request
Define schemas/context-pack.schema.json (hand-maintained, ADR 0008) with positive and negative fixtures; pack serialization validates against it
Expose typed application APIs (resolve, related, trace, build_pack) for the CLI and MCP layers; no CLI wiring this order
Document ranking and budget semantics in docs/reference/context-packs.md
non_goals: No CLI commands (lead wires ref/context-pack commands after integration)
No projection schema changes — consume WP-210 query APIs; needing a new index is a coordination request to the lead, not a cross-package edit
No embeddings, vector search, or LLM calls: deterministic retrieval only
deliverables: Retrieval package with resolution, traversal, trace, ranking, and pack assembly plus tests
acceptance_criteria: A fixture workspace resolves a task to its context pack containing all ten doc-03 sections with correct current-vs-superseded claims
Trace from a claim reaches the exact observation and source locator (UC-004)
Ranking order is deterministic and unit-tested against crafted fixtures per factor
Budgeted packs truncate in the documented order and always include truncation metadata; identical inputs produce identical packs
Packs validate against context-pack.schema.json (positive and negative fixtures per ADR 0008)
Cross-context references are refused (require_context enforced at the retrieval boundary)
security_constraints: Fictional fixtures only; packs must never include secret-looking values from workspace content in cleartext summaries (pass through the existing secret patterns as a filter guard)
stop_conditions: A required query shape WP-210's APIs cannot serve (raise a coordination request; do not edit the adapter)
Any needed change to frozen files or domain models
